status: New prospective specification; not a reconstruction or recoding of the earlier archive

strength.1: Tentative but explicit positive selection advice, such as You could choose
strength.2: Explicit selection advice without tentative wording or an intensifier
strength.3: Strong advice with an explicit intensifier
strength.constraints: Scores 1 through 4 imply direct recommendation. Single-best selection is a separate field. Conditional suitability alone does not imply tentativeness.

support_rule: No assessable excerpt -> inaccessible; any material contradiction -> unsupported; all material atoms supported -> full; supported plus unestablished atoms with no contradiction -> partial; all unestablished -> unsupported
availability: Unavailable evidence is a link-level state; no atomic support labels assigned
agreement: Constructed deterministic streams illustrate specified procedure agreement, not independent human coder reliability or validity
new_scope: independent human coding workflow for future applications
